verdict.rationale: Because Mintlify renders sites from your own Git repository, page content is already stored as open Markdown/MDX (mintlify-docs-1, mintlify-docs-9/23), the CLI supports a static `mint export` for air-gapped/offline deployment (mintlify-probe-rt-5), and the REST API can export analytics data (mintlify-docs-21) — giving a real path to take your data and leave. However there is no single documented 'export all account data' feature covering integrations/settings/assistant history in one open bundle, and community feedback flags the platform as proprietary SaaS with data flowing through their servers (mintlify-comm-1, mintlify-comm-2, mintlify-comm-3). Missing for 10: a unified full-account export mechanism, and independent confirmation that exported content is fully self-hostable without Mintlify infrastructure.
